data_driven_stability.note: Hybrid arm (M4) built from this threshold is FLAGGED AS LEAKED (see below) -- threshold recorded for provenance only, not endorsed for reuse without a corrected nested-within-nested implementation.

preprocessing.imputation: median (SimpleImputer), fit on training/discovery data only
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler, fit on training/discovery data only

high_dim_pca.fit_on: all 302 Gangnam discovery patients only, frozen loadings in M3_pca_loadings/
high_dim_pca.known_limitation: Phase-2 prevalence filter (structured/*_filtered.tsv column lists) was computed on all 302 Gangnam patients unsupervised (outcome-blind) and is not re-derived per any downstream split -- documented, not silent.

patient_report_templates.reference_cohort: Gangnam discovery (N=302) only, applied unchanged to public cohorts

clustering.method: KMeans, K=2 (silhouette-selected, Gangnam-only per lit13b -- all-cohort clustering in lit13 found to trivially recover COHORT identity, not phenotype, and was discarded)
clustering.interpretation: weak structure (silhouette ~0.1-0.15); mortality difference between clusters is directionally plausible but not strongly supported given the weak separation -- consistent with the project's repeated finding that unsupervised structure alone carries limited information.

M0_simple_ecology.status: reference baseline only, not frozen as a model artifact

M1_literature_core.status: FROZEN, recommended candidate for Phase VIII/X

M2_literature_extended.status: not separately frozen (Core preferred; Extended's 1 extra feature was not literature-tier-anchored)

M3_data_driven.status: FROZEN, recommended candidate for Phase VIII/X (best internal discriminator)

M4_hybrid.status: NOT FROZEN -- internal-CV result (0.841 LR / 0.721 CatBoost) confirmed LEAKED via external validation (external AUROC 0.50-0.59, WORSE than M1 alone). See supervised_semantic/model_comparison_M0_M4_external.md.

S1_literature_embedding.status: chance-level, NOT useful beyond structured features

S2_hybrid_embedding.status: modest, comparable to M1/M3 but adds no clear advantage over structured features; not frozen as a separate model artifact

structured_plus_semantic_hybrid.status: NOT FROZEN -- same leakage source as M4 (includes the same 71 stability-selected features)
